strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal weak-network VPN for OpenWrt/Linux/Windows with a TCP-shaped WBD raw/FakeTCP carrier, datagram-like no-HOL inner delivery, real DTLS 1.3, optional/adaptive WBD FEC, optional browser-like TLS Persona, concurrent multi-device sessions per account, and client-selectable global/China/non-China capture.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: V2-M8B-T2: mathematically and empirically qualify minimum-first-arrival FEC scheduling, then implement runtime off/fixed configuration epochs as the substrate for later client-side Auto FEC.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not delay an available systematic source to fill a FEC block. Optimize earliest complete original datagram subject to delivery-tail, CPU/RSS, wire overhead and path-capacity headroom. Keep one lane as baseline and do not add blind dual-lane duplication before one-lane adaptive protection has a measured cliff.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Qualified the WBD-owned outer carrier and removed systematic FEC batching from the first-arrival path. Native FakeTCP pcap qualification at 20 ms RTT / symmetric 20% random loss shows TCP-shaped SYN/SYN-ACK/ACK, MSS 1360, SACK-Permitted, Window Scale 8, cumulative ACK, merged live SACK blocks, three-duplicate-ACK fast retransmission, roughly 1 s first RTO and exponential backoff while complete out-of-order datagrams bypass TCP sequence holes. WBD FastBlockEncoder now emits every systematic source immediately and only emits repair when the block becomes encodable/flushes; BlockDecoder immediately returns first-seen systematic originals while retaining equations for later missing-source reconstruction. GitHub Actions fullstack-first-arrival run 32841039689 passed all RTT 20/100 ms x loss 0/10/20% points. At 20% loss: RTT20 delivered 800/800 with p50 10.374 ms, p95 17.825 ms, p99 20.077 ms; RTT100 delivered 800/800 with p50 50.379 ms, p95 58.115 ms, p99 59.769 ms. The prior batching p50 values were about 15.209/55.679 ms, so immediate systematic transmission removed about 4.8/5.3 ms median block-wait cost. Product planning was then updated in PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md, ROADMAP.md and ADR-0005 to admit optional off/fixed/qualified-auto FEC, client-driven policy with server resource caps, same-account concurrent device sessions, global/only-cn/only-non-cn routing with underlay escape, client-selected Persona profile with server-owned certificate/domain, and deferred non-blind dual-lane research. internal/fec/planner.go + planner_test.go now encode the iid MDS planning tail and repair-debt lower bound. For K=20 and ideal iid P_fail <=1e-5, minimum R is 4/8/12/16/20 at loss 1/5/10/15/20%; for <=1e-3 it is 3/6/9/12/15.
continuation_cursor.current_task: Build the deterministic FEC scheduling simulator/sweeper described by ADR-0005. Compare current full-block systematic RS with tail repair, smaller/micro-block RS, and a causal/sliding-window repair model. The objective is first-complete per-original latency including repair causality and offered-load/capacity queue cost, not merely block recovery probability.
continuation_cursor.why_now: Streaming systematic source transmission has already put the unaffected majority of packets near the one-way propagation floor. The remaining FEC latency is concentrated on lost systematic sources, whose recovery currently waits for tail repair availability. Random-loss math proves that fixed 20:20 is excessive on good links and that repairs should be made available as early/evenly as causality allows; a measured scheduler surface is required before implementing Auto.
continuation_cursor.done_when: A deterministic repository-backed simulator reports p50/p95/p99 first-complete latency, decode/delivery probability and intentional wire ratio for tail-block RS, micro-block RS and a causal streaming-repair model across at least iid loss 0/1/5/10/15/20%, several offered-load/capacity ratios and representative burst traces. The model must verify the ideal MDS block tail against planner.go, expose when repair expansion drives utilization toward saturation, and identify a bounded scheduler candidate. Then implement negotiated config epochs and runtime fec.mode=off|fixed without reconnect; Auto remains disabled until estimator/hysteresis tests exist.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: Extend or replace cmd/wbd-fec-sweep with a deterministic timing/capacity simulator that emits source opportunities immediately and timestamps the first time each original is directly received or becomes solvable. Add tail-block RS, micro-block RS, and causal sliding-window repair schedules; include serialization/queue delay from payload*(1+repair_ratio)/capacity, iid and burst loss, fixed seeds, and CSV/JSON output. Add deterministic tests for the known K=20 binomial thresholds and scheduler ordering before changing the live transport codec.

udp_like_status.outer_semantics: WBD-owned TCP-shaped raw carrier with shadow cumulative ACK/SACK/fast-retransmit/RTO state; inner complete datagram delivery never waits for cumulative TCP ACK
udp_like_status.fec_status: WBD systematic 20+20 RS is qualified as a strong fixed reference. Systematic sources stream immediately. Repair scheduling remains tail-block and is the current optimization target; future product modes are off|fixed|qualified-auto and may be directional.
udp_like_status.fullstack_run: GitHub Actions 32841039689 SUCCESS, RTT 20/100 ms x loss 0/10/20%, 800 1200-byte datagrams per point
udp_like_status.tcp_like_pcap: 20% real pcap gate passed with MSS=1360, SACK-Permitted, Window Scale=8, cumulative ACK, up to four live merged SACK blocks, third-dup-ACK fast retransmit, ~1 s RTO and exponential backoff
udp_like_status.memory_policy: performance first: SACKed-but-not-cumulatively-ACKed payload remains retained for shadow retransmission and new inner datagrams are not gated by pending depth; BDP memory is measured rather than optimized away
udp_like_status.tcp_retransmission_scope: qualified TCP-shaped shadow behavior, not a claim of a full RFC TCP congestion-control/byte-stream implementation

product_policy.fec: client/session chooses off or fixed now and qualified auto later; server advertises supported code/scheduler versions and hard resource/wire caps; config changes use coding-window epochs
product_policy.accounts: same username/account may own multiple simultaneous device sessions; live state keyed by account plus unique session id; prefer per-device high-entropy credentials and independent revocation
product_policy.routing: client capture modes off|global|only-cn|only-non-cn; mandatory underlay endpoint escape; Linux/OpenWrt use policy routing/prefix sets; Windows uses Wintun-class L3 plus broad routes or compact WFP/equivalent split classifier, never thousands of persistent firewall rules
product_policy.persona: ClientHello browser profile is client-selected from server-supported set; operator hostname/certificate/private key are server-owned; Persona is separate real TLS 1.3 preflight and does not replace DTLS
product_policy.dual_lane: deferred until one-lane adaptive FEC cliff is measured; prefer striped/hedged independent repair with lane-specific equations/seeds/timing rather than byte-identical duplication; any >2x survival mode requires separate admission
